Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Traits & Breed Selector Redesign: Redesign the companion selection screen into a visual trait picker grid with instant posture animation previews. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 71.1% with a high mean completion time of 1017s, indicating user friction during companion setup.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Dock Placement Setup Screen: Adds a dedicated desktop dock placement screen allowing users to pick where their pet stays on screen before completing onboarding. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or app failing to display after finishing setup.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Account Persistence Warning Banner: Adds explicit safety microcopy reassuring users that signing in prevents pet data resets across app updates. (why: 8 support complaints cited missing or reset pets after re-authenticating.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Hotkeys Quick Reference Overview: Adds an interactive hotkey visual map on the final screen detailing how to hide, wake, or summon the pet. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling or hiding the companion after setup.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Certificate Stamp Highlight: Adds an official adoption badge seal animation and customizable companion pledge banner to the certificate screen. (why: Adoption has a 28.9% user drop-off rate, needing stronger emotional momentum prior to desktop generation.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Desktop Pet Companion Showcase Intro Screen: Adds an animated desktop preview screen before path selection displaying pet interaction capabilities. (why: Users take an average of 514s on path selection; previewing real companion behaviors upfront accelerates decision-making.)
